```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load required packages for data manipulation and visualization
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

load data 
```{r cars}
# load files
load("../data/Extended Data Fig/Extended Data Fig5/oral_gut_abundance_melt.RData")        # Melted abundance data
load("../data/Extended Data Fig/Extended Data Fig5/trans2.RData")                         # Strain-Level Transmission Information
load("../data/Extended Data Fig/Extended Data Fig5/shared_new9.RData")                    # Shared microbial features data
```

Data Preparation for PMA Effect Analysis

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
# Subset data to include only cancer diagnoses (CRC, GC, EC)
pma_effect <- subset(oral_gut_abundance, Diagnosis %in% c("CRC", "GC", "EC"))

# Identify gut-only SGBs (present in gut but not in oral samples)
gut_only <- subset(oral_gut_abundance, oral == 0 & gut > 0)

# Count occurrences of each SGB by treatment group
stat <- gut_only %>% group_by(SGB, group) %>% summarise(counts = n())

# Reshape to wide format for comparison
stat <- stat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = counts)

# Filter for SGBs with sufficient representation (≥10 samples in either group)
gut_sgb <- subset(stat, PMA >= 10 | `non-PMA` >= 10)

# Classify SGBs as either "gut_only" or "shared" (oral-gut transmitted)
shared_vs_gut <- pma_effect %>% 
  mutate(type = case_when(
    SGB %in% gut_sgb$SGB ~ "gut_only",
    SGB %in% unique(shared_new9$X2) ~ "shared"
  ))

# Remove unclassified entries and prepare data for ratio calculation
shared_vs_gut <- subset(shared_vs_gut, !is.na(type))
shared_vs_gut <- shared_vs_gut[, -4]  # Remove unnecessary column
shared_vs_gut$id <- gsub("_PMA", "", shared_vs_gut$id)  # Standardize sample IDs

# Reshape to wide format with separate columns for PMA and non-PMA abundances
shared_vs_gut <- shared_vs_gut %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = gut)
shared_vs_gut[is.na(shared_vs_gut)] <- 0  # Replace NAs with zeros
```

PMA Effect Ratio (PER) Calculation
```{r}
# Separate shared (transmitted) and gut-only (resident) SGBs
shared_data <- shared_vs_gut %>% filter(type == "shared")
gut_only_data <- shared_vs_gut %>% filter(type == "gut_only")

# Calculate PMA Effect Ratio (PER) for each transmitted strain relative to each resident SGB
# PER = log10((Rt/Rr)PMA / (Dt/Dr)non-PMA)
# Where: Rt/Rr = transmitted/resident ratio in PMA-treated samples
#        Dt/Dr = transmitted/resident ratio in untreated samples
result <- shared_data %>%
  left_join(
    gut_only_data, 
    by = "id", 
    suffix = c("_shared", "_gut")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    ratio_nonPMA = `non-PMA_shared` / `non-PMA_gut`,  # Untreated ratio
    ratio_PMA = PMA_shared / PMA_gut                  # PMA-treated ratio
  ) %>%
  # Select and rename key columns
  select(
    id,
    SGB_shared,              # Transmitted SGB
    SGB_gut,                 # Resident SGB
    site = site_shared,      # Sample site
    Diagnosis = Diagnosis_shared,  # Cancer diagnosis
    
    # Abundance values for transmitted SGB
    non_PMA_shared = `non-PMA_shared`,
    PMA_shared,
    
    # Abundance values for resident SGB
    non_PMA_gut = `non-PMA_gut`,
    PMA_gut,
    
    # Calculated ratios
    ratio_nonPMA,
    ratio_PMA
  )

# Calculate PMA Effect Ratio (PER)
result$PER <- log10(result$ratio_PMA / result$ratio_nonPMA)

# Remove infinite values resulting from division by zero
result_clean <- result %>% filter(is.finite(PER))
```
Incorporate Strain-Level Transmission Information
```{r}
# Load and process transmission data
trans <- subset(trans2, trans == "YES")  # Confirmed transmitted strains
trans$ID1 <- gsub("_PMA", "", trans$ID1)  # Standardize sample IDs

# Separate transmission data by treatment
trans_nonpma <- trans[trans$treatment.x == "non-PMA", c("ID1", "SGB", "species", "trans")]
trans_pma <- trans[trans$treatment.x == "PMA", c("ID1", "SGB", "species", "trans")]

# Merge transmission information with PER results
result_clean1 <- merge(result_clean, trans_nonpma, 
                       by.x = c("id", "SGB_shared"), 
                       by.y = c("ID1", "SGB"), 
                       all.x = TRUE)

result_clean1 <- merge(result_clean1, trans_pma, 
                       by.x = c("id", "SGB_shared"), 
                       by.y = c("ID1", "SGB"), 
                       all.x = TRUE)
```
PMA Sensitivity Index (PSI) Calculation
```{r}
# Filter for transmitted strains with significant PMA effect (PER > 1 or < -1)
tmp2 <- subset(result_clean1, (trans.x == "YES" | trans.y == "YES") & (PER >= 1 | PER <= -1))
tmp2 <- unique(tmp2)

# Classify comparison direction (PMA vs non-PMA dominance)
tmp2 <- tmp2 %>% mutate(compare = case_when(
  ratio_nonPMA > ratio_PMA ~ "non-PMA",
  ratio_nonPMA < ratio_PMA ~ "PMA"
))

# Count resident SGBs with PER > 1 (n) and PER < -1 (m) for each transmitted strain
stat <- tmp2 %>% group_by(SGB_shared, compare) %>% summarise(count = n())
colnames(stat) <- c("SGB", "group", "number")

# Reshape to wide format for PSI calculation
stat <- stat %>% pivot_wider(names_from = group, values_from = number)
stat[is.na(stat)] <- 0  # Replace NAs with zeros

# Calculate PMA Sensitivity Index (PSI): PSI = (n - m) / (n + m)
stat$PSI <- (stat$`non-PMA` - stat$PMA) / (stat$`non-PMA` + stat$PMA)

# Add species information for better interpretation
species <- unique(trans2[, c("SGB", "species")])
species <- subset(species, !is.na(species))
stat <- merge(stat, species, by = "SGB", all.x = TRUE)

# Create formatted labels for visualization
stat$id <- paste(stat$species, stat$SGB)
stat$id <- gsub("_unclassified_SGB19850", "", stat$id)
stat$id <- gsub("_group", "", stat$id)
stat$id <- gsub("s__", "", stat$id)
```
Visualization of PMA Sensitivity Index 
```{r}
# Order strains by PSI value for visualization
stat <- stat[order(stat$PSI, decreasing = TRUE), ]
stat$id <- factor(stat$id, levels = stat$id)

# Create dot plot of PSI values
ggplot(stat, aes(PSI, id)) +
  geom_point() +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(x = "PMA Sensitivity Index (PSI)", 
       y = "Transmitted Strains",
       title = "PMA Sensitivity of Transmitted Oral Microbes",
       subtitle = "Positive PSI: Higher viability after PMA treatment\nNegative PSI: Lower viability after PMA treatment")
ggsave("../results/fig5h.pdf",height=10,width=6)
```
